nom: The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors + Hyaluronic Acid Daily Moisturizer

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: some say it is lightweight, non-greasy and controls their t-zone over the day, while others warn it is a grease bomb or unsuitable if you are oily/breakout-prone.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers most often report it as a staple that fixes dry patches and leaves skin soft, but a minority with dry or mature skin still wake up with dry patches or find it not moisturizing enough.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally describe it as lightweight, non-clogging and good under makeup, with the t-zone staying only minimally oily.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report it calms and soothes irritation without stinging, though one reviewer with sensitive/combo skin still had to watch for clogged pores.
segments.normal: Normal-skin reviewers (often normal-to-dry or normal-to-oily) describe it as a reliable, non-greasy everyday moisturizer.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers are divided: one calls it a nice affordable pick, another finds it too light, leaving dry patches by morning.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines and dullness report smoother, plumper, glass-like skin and improved texture/tone; no negative reports specific to aging are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Many report resolved dry patches and all-day hydration, but a notable group says it did not moisturize enough, absorbed too fast, or even left skin drier than before.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports it helped even tone and calm redness; no dissenting reports on redness specifically.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes visible barrier repair (itchiness and irritation gone) when paired with benzoyl peroxide; no negative reports on barrier specifically, though several unrelated rashes/hives are noted elsewhere.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports noticeable improvement in sun spots after four weeks combined with vitamin C and retinol; no dissent on this specific use.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report it does not break them out and even clears bumps or hormonal acne; however multiple others report new cystic acne, blackheads, whiteheads, or breakouts they attribute directly to this product.
concerns.oiliness: Some oily/combo reviewers say it leaves a matte, non-greasy finish and reduces shine over the day; others describe it as sitting heavy, sticky, or an outright 'grease bomb.'

aspects.libelle: Small amount goes a long way
Suspected formula change / inconsistency between batches
Greasy or tacky finish on skin

extraits.texte: I have had the worst skin for the past year or 2 itchy, red, inflamed, dry and flaky patches and acne, finally stumbled upon a tik tok talking about Benzoyl peroxide being way better than other acne products but it's drying to the skin. As a last effort I bought Pan Oxyl's BP and I bought THIS moisturizer in hopes it would keep my skin from getting even more irritated and dry. I was terrified but when I tell you that my skin has never ever been so smooth and hydrated! I thought my skin barrier was a myth it was so damaged but I know it is being rebuilt as I use this cream. I bought this a month ago and have had no irritations. Dry patches gone, itchiness gone. My pores are shrinking. One day when I go to a lower BP I'll switch to a gel moisturizer that I hope the Ordinary comes out with bc I can tell I won't need this intense hydration forever. This is not for oily skin, do not waste your time.

I struggle with texture, clogged pores, and black heads. The medication I use requires a 'no active ingredients' moisturizer. I thought i found it in this moisturizer, since they advertise as non-comedogenic. This formula actually contains Oleic Acid, which is a pore clogging ingredient. I didnt realize this and my texture and black heads were awful even with my medication. When I switched to a different moisturizer without clogging ingredients, the issue stopped immediately. I suggest that if you deal with texture or clogging pores, dont use this moisturizer.

I tried this out because I needed to get away from SkinMedica Ultra Sheer Moisturizer for the price point. I have combo skin and it is sensitive to the point where something may feel nice but may also clog my pores. I am prone to oil in my t-zone. If I don't moisturize, my skin flares. This all being said, I just started using this cream and can say it can seem thick or heavy. I would recommend you just give it a second to settle in and be absorbed because my skin eats this UP. I was prepared to return this but am hoping it is my new moisturizer! Previously, I actually had some clogged pores from trying to use the very end of the SKM bottle. After a few days of this, they are gone! And no dry spots! My face is super soft and my t-zone is very minimally greasy. A little goes a long way.
It's nice for someone who is looking for a light moisturizer. Too light for mature skin though; using it a night but still waking up with dry patches.

I have sensitive skin and have been using this moisturizer for a while now. It calms and soothes irritated skin within just a few uses. I pair it with Cold Pressed Rose Hip Oil at night and with Alpha Arbutin in the morning and my skin is radiant.

I absolutely am in love with this moisturizer!! It creates an all over barrier without making my oily skin worse throughout the day. I pair it with The Ordinary niacinamide serum and my hormonal acne skin hasn't been this clear in a long time!! It's on my buy again list!

This has been my favorite moisturizer for years, but this last tube I bought is awful. What happened? I look like somebody has poured oil all over my face and no amount of make up or powder will hide it. Never going to buy this again. Incredibly disappointed and bummed.
